Soap Bubbles

Q1 · B. Soap film around air
A soap bubble is a thin watery soap film wrapped around a pocket of air.
Q2 · C. Light in the thin film
Light reflecting in the thin film can make shifting color stripes as thickness changes.
Q3 · A. Film pulls into a sphere
Surface tension pulls evenly, and a sphere uses the least film for the air inside.
Q4 · A. The film gets a hole
When the film breaks from thinning, drying, dust, or a touch, the bubble pops.
C1 · Say it your way
evaporate: when liquid water turns into vapor in the air.
C2 · Draw it
Look for: Read your words aloud. Did you connect a clue (color, shape, or pop) to an explanation?
